name: Volunteer's Dilemma
summary: Multiplayer chicken game where everyone benefits if at least one person pays a cost to volunteer.
rules_text: Each of N players simultaneously chooses Volunteer or Abstain. Volunteering incurs a personal cost but produces a public benefit. If at least one player volunteers, volunteers receive payoff a, abstainers receive higher payoff c. If no one volunteers, all receive low payoff d, where c > a > d. In the two-player general form, if opponent may volunteer, volunteering gives b and abstaining gives a; if opponent abstains, volunteering gives a and abstaining gives d, with c>a,b>d and c>b. Play one round with these payoffs.
rating_reason: Classic simultaneous volunteer's dilemma, strategic choice game
